hook.line: On track to make over $10,000 in two months of part-time UGC with zero experience.
hook.visual: Creator leans into the camera on a bed with a red mug; a typewriter title builds 'How to build a $10,000 UGC portfolio' over her, then payment-notification cards pop in at 2.6 s.

beats.what: Mic held up, title types itself in word by word with '(with ZERO experience)' underneath
Four green '+$1,500 / +$6,000' payout cards pop in around her as proof of the claim
Series title 'the $5k experiment' in large serif plus bold yellow type
Cut to a closer frame; Step 1 shown as a screenshot of her own skimmable bullet-point bio
'STEP 2: 3-5 sample videos' handwritten title at the top
Arrow and 'MY SAMPLE AD' label point to a phone mockup playing her sample video
Phone mockup of a portfolio tile with a hand-drawn white circle around the format label
Three handwritten bullets list what brands want: lighting, audio, personality
Handwritten 'follow for more content like this :)' as she says follow along

why_it_works: Money result and payout cards shown in the first 3 s, so the viewer stays to learn how it was done
'with ZERO experience' lowers the bar, so beginners feel the steps apply to them
Numbered step titles at the top act as chapter markers, so viewers know progress through a 97 s video
Her own bio and sample-ad phone mockups prove each step instead of only describing it
weaknesses: Long single framing (longest shot 46.6 s, 3.71 cuts/min) leans entirely on her delivery
Step 4 has no title card, so the numbered structure breaks near the end
Most text sits outside the safe area (0.807 share), risking overlap with TikTok UI
for_robert: Pop small proof cards (real numbers or results) around his head in the first 3 s, and give each step a top title card; Fred could carry or deliver the step card.
